title: 第 8 讲：综合实战 — 技术短文句析

reading.title: Why Scripts Beat Memory

sentences.en: Not because our memory is weak, but because we juggle too many tasks.
sentences.zh: 不是因为记性差，而是因为我们同时玩转的任务太多。

sentences.en: Last month, I forgot to renew a certificate, and the whole service went down for an hour.
sentences.zh: 上个月，我忘了续一个证书，整个服务挂了一个小时。

sentences.en: Since then, my rule has been simple: if a task happens twice, it becomes a script.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，我的规则很简单：一个任务发生两次，它就变成一个脚本。

sentences.en: My scripts now check the backups, run the reports, and keep the logs clean.
sentences.zh: 我的脚本现在检查备份、跑报表、保持日志干净。

sentences.en: When something breaks, the pipeline tells me the result before users do.
sentences.zh: 出问题的时候，流水线比用户更早把结果告诉我。

sentences.en: Nobody remembers everything; good systems remember for us.
sentences.zh: 没人记得住所有事；好的系统替我们记。

sentences.en: Writing a script takes ten minutes, but it keeps working for years.
sentences.zh: 写一个脚本只要十分钟，但它能连续工作好几年。

sentences.en: The first version was ugly, but it worked.
I have improved it week by week, and today it saves me hours every month.
sentences.zh: 我一周一周地改进它，如今它每月为我省下数小时。

sentences.en: Rarely does a small tool pay off so well — small efforts, repeated automatically, turn into big results.
sentences.zh: 一个小工具很少有这么高的回报——小的努力被自动化地重复，就变成大的成果。

sentences.en: That is what I call leverage.
sentences.zh: 这就是我所说的杠杆效应。

reading.translation: 开发者会忘事。不是因为记性差，而是因为我们同时玩转的任务太多。上个月，我忘了续一个证书，整个服务挂了一个小时。从那以后，我的规则很简单：一个任务发生两次，它就变成一个脚本。我的脚本现在检查备份、跑报表、保持日志干净。出问题的时候，流水线比用户更早把结果告诉我。没人记得住所有事；好的系统替我们记。写一个脚本只要十分钟，但它能连续工作好几年。第一版很丑，但它能用。我一周一周地改进它，如今它每月为我省下数小时。一个小工具很少有这么高的回报——小的努力被自动化地重复，就变成大的成果。这就是我所说的杠杆效应。

keyPoints.sentence: Since then, my rule has been simple.
keyPoints.analysis: since then + 状态持续至今 → 现在完成

keyPoints.sentence: if a task happens twice, it becomes a script.
keyPoints.analysis: 主将从现（L05）：从句一般现在，becomes 也是一般现在表规律

keyPoints.sentence: Writing a script takes ten minutes.
keyPoints.analysis: 动名词短语作主语 = 单数（L06 一致 + U03 钩子）

keyPoints.sentence: Rarely does a small tool pay off so well.
keyPoints.analysis: 否定倒装（L07）：还原 = A small tool rarely pays off so well.

practice.title: 全句标注 — 对下列课文句标注「成分 + 句型（①~⑤）+ 时态」

questions.stem: Last month, I forgot to renew a certificate.
questions.answer: Last month(状), I(S) forgot(V) to renew a certificate(O) — ② 主谓宾 ｜ 过去一般

questions.stem: Writing a script takes ten minutes.
questions.answer: Writing a script(S，动名词短语) takes(V) ten minutes(O) — ② ｜ 现在一般（动名词主语 = 单数）

questions.stem: When something breaks, the pipeline tells me before users do.
questions.answer: When something breaks(状从，现在一般), the pipeline(S) tells(V) me(O·间) the result(O·直) before users do(状从) — ③ 主谓双宾 ｜ 现在一般

questions.stem: Rarely does a small tool pay off so well.
questions.answer: Rarely(状，否定倒装), does(助) a small tool(S) pay(V) off(动介) so well(状) — ① 主谓 ｜ 现在一般（倒装不改变时态）

practice.title: 时态定位 — 说出下列句子的「时间 × 体」坐标

questions.stem: My rule has been simple since then.
questions.explanation: has been，since then 持续至今

questions.stem: I have improved it week by week.
questions.explanation: have improved，week by week 累计影响至今

practice.title: 改错 — 每句一处，覆盖前七讲

questions.stem: Every one of my scripts have a name.
questions.reference: Every one of my scripts has a name.

questions.stem: If a task will happen twice, it becomes a script.
questions.reference: If a task happens twice, it becomes a script.

questions.stem: The build has broke again this morning.
questions.reference: The build has broken again this morning.
questions.explanation: 完成分词用 broken（break → broke → broken，L02 形态表）

practice.title: 自动化小故事 — 写 5 句（3 种时态 + 1 句主将从现 + 1 句 nobody / everybody），主题：你生活或工作中的自动化

questions.stem: 写你自己的自动化小故事 5 句：3 种时态 + 1 句主将从现 + 1 句 nobody / everybody，主题为你生活或工作中的自动化。

checklist.label: 要点覆盖
checklist.text: 过去一般 ≥1（讲起因）、现在一般 ≥1（讲规律）、现在完成 ≥1（讲影响）；1 句 if/when 主将从现；1 句 nobody / everybody 开头

checklist.label: 自检要点
checklist.text: if/when 从句中无 will；nobody / everybody 后谓语单数；三句时态能画出时间轴

checklist.label: 达标线
checklist.text: 对照本讲 3.1 时态地图，5 句各就各位，即通过

practice.title: 合并挑战（Unit 02 预告） — 把每组的两个简单句合并成一个复合句（用 when / because）

questions.stem: The backup finished. The alarm stopped.（when）
answers: When the backup finished, the alarm stopped.
questions.explanation: when 引导时间状语从句

questions.stem: We trust the pipeline. It checks everything.（because）
answers: We trust the pipeline because it checks everything.
questions.explanation: because 引导原因状语从句
